gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Offside's curves refuse to close, spaced wide and held at a single stroke width from edge to edge. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri sits below it, plain sans, short ascenders and tall x-height.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-syriac-weste: Wide-spaced and swell-free, Offside lets its open curves run without a single pressure bulge. Offside leads with that stillness, while Noto Sans Syriac Western packs its small sans-serif letters dense and tall.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Offside spreads its unclosed curves across wide tracking, with stems and arcs moving in lockstep and no weight accents. Then Noto Sans Tagalog fills the middle of each line with a dense, generous texture beneath it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Commanding, mostly. Offside holds its parallel-edged curves apart with wide tracking, and Noto Sans Tagbanwa follows underneath, its open sans-serif lowercase filling nearly the full height of each line.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Curves left deliberately open, spaced wide, drawn with one fixed nib width: that is Offside. Noto Sans Tai Le tapers its strokes out before they touch, and that gentle step from capital to lowercase is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Offside draws every curve with no thin parts and no swells, then spaces the letters wide. And Noto Sans Tai Tham crowds its chalk-board lowercase up toward the capital line, so shrinking the heading would blur that gap.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Offside keeps a level beat, with no weight accents anywhere. Noto Sans Tai Viet adds short ascenders and a tall x-height beneath it, so the sans-serif text sits close and tidy under the heading's wide, open tracking.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-takri: Offside builds its headlines from strokes of constant width, like bent pipe, with curves that stay unclosed and widely tracked. Noto Sans Takri carries a long text run in high-waisted sans lowercase, quick to follow.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Offside's stroke width never wavers, curve after curve. Noto Sans Thai Looped makes a long passage feel bold and full-bodied, since its tall lowercase leaves spacious gaps at every curve's end.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Offside is expressive in a restrained way, with crossbars as fat as their stems and curves that never quite close. But shrink that heading and the wide tracking weakens, while Noto Sans Tifinagh's inflated, rounded lowercase would hold up.
